title: Affine computation of derived pullback and derived tensor product
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with derived pullback $Lf^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] and derived categories as in [def-pc-derived-category]; for a scheme $Z$ write $K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_Z}L$ for the derived tensor product, the total tensor complex [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] of a K-flat resolution of $K$ [def-pc-kflat-complex] with $L$. (1) For opens $U\subseteq X$, $V\subseteq Y$ with $f(U)\subseteq V$ and $E$ in $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ there is a canonical isomorphism $(Lf^*E)|_U\cong L(f|_U)^*(E|_V)$ in $D(\mathcal O_U)$, and for $K,L$ in $D(\mathcal O_X)$ a canonical isomorphism $(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}L)|_U\cong K|_U\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_U}L|_U$. (2) If $X=\operatorname{Spec}(B)$, $Y=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ and $f$ is given by a ring map $A\to B$, then for every complex $M^\bullet$ of $A$-modules $Lf^*\widetilde{M^\bullet}\cong\widetilde{M^\bullet\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B}$ in $D(\mathcal O_X)$, where $\widetilde{(-)}$ is the termwise associated sheaf [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections] and $\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}$ the derived tensor product of complexes of modules. (3) If $X=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$, then for complexes $M^\bullet,N^\bullet$ of $A$-modules $\widetilde{M^\bullet}\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}\widetilde{N^\bullet}\cong\widetilde{M^\bullet\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}N^\bullet}$ in $D(\mathcal O_X)$.

proof.text: Extract the tensor-pullback counit and K-flat computation from def-pc-derived-pullback. For composable f and g, use the already proved ordinary tensor-pullback composition isomorphism (lem-pc-module-pullback-identity-composition), lift it to homotopy categories, and compose the three counits to obtain the left-derived lift into L(f composed with g). It is invertible on K-flat representatives because pullback preserves K-flatness (lem-pc-kflat-pullback-preservation). For every derived object, take a K-flat resolution (lem-pc-kflat-resolution); naturality and the invertible localized resolution transport this invertibility to that object. This proves the private composition comparison with only the three local derived-category instances, without needing a family of instances on every scheme.

proof.text: Tensor pullback along an open inclusion and exact over-site restriction followed by overEquiv are naturally isomorphic: the proved nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction in def-pc-module-pullback and Mathlib restrictAdjunction make both left adjoint to ordinary pushforward, and Mathlib overFunctorEquiv identifies the restriction descriptions. Lift this ordinary isomorphism to homotopy categories. Exact restriction has the localized functor mapDerivedCategory as a left derived functor by Mathlib isLeftDerivedFunctor_of_inverts and mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh. Uniqueness of left derived functors identifies it with the chosen derivedPullback of the open inclusion. Apply the composition comparison twice to the equality U.ι composed with f = f.resLE V U hUV composed with V.ι. Whiskering the two open-inclusion identifications gives derivedPullback_openRestriction_iso, naturally in the derived object.

proof.text: Use def-pc-derived-pullback-monoidal-model for the open inclusion U.ι. Transport its strong monoidal structure through the exact-open-restriction isomorphism just proved. Mathlib Functor.curriedTensorPreIsoPost gives the natural tensor comparison for the transported restriction functor. Its inverse is exactly derivedTensor_openRestriction_iso. Thus both variables are natural without selecting nonfunctorial resolutions or assembling arbitrary objectwise isomorphisms.

proof.text: For affine pullback on K-flat module models, convert the categorical module K-flat predicate to acyclicity of tensor with an acyclic complex using the homotopy-category K-flat criterion. Apply [lem-pc-affine-tilde-kflat]. Use the proved private tensorDerivedCounit helper to extract the tensor-pullback part of the chosen derived pullback specification. The object and morphism equations prove equality of the recorded ordinary functor with tensorPullback. Unpack its counit [def-pc-derived-pullback]; it is invertible on those tilde complexes. Whisker this invertible counit and the natural tilde/base-change comparison [lem-weil-pbc-tilde-pullback-base-change], lifted degreewise to complexes. Compose with quotientCompQhIso and mapHomotopyCategoryFactors to obtain derivedPullback_tilde_kFlat_natIso. The private complexDerivedCounitIso and complexFunctorSquareIso prove the two formal comparisons over abstract categories; complexDerivedSquareIso composes them before specialization. Its application explicitly pins both shared sheaf-module categories and passes the proved counit-isomorphism instance, avoiding unnecessary concrete definitional reductions. These helpers have complete proofs and introduce no new assumptions or unresolved nodes.

For the natural affine tensor comparison, termwise tilde of each module K-flat model is K-flat by [lem-pc-affine-tilde-kflat], after the proved homotopy-category acyclicity criterion. Apply [lem-pc-kflat-derived-tensor-comparison] to these first models and arbitrary tilde second models. The statement [lem-pc-affine-tilde-total-tensor] already includes localization by Q; precompose its first variable with the K-flat inclusion, and compose the two natural isomorphisms. This proves derivedTensor_tilde_kFlat_natIso by composition of distinct derived and underived computations.

For any specified quasi-isomorphism s:P→M, use the functor factorization in [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence] to show that Q(tilde(s)) is an isomorphism: Q inverts s, and the equivalence and full-subcategory inclusion preserve isomorphisms. Invert this isomorphism, apply derived pullback for the pullback formula or tensor with Q(tilde(N)) for the tensor formula, then compose with the component at P of the corresponding K-flat natural comparison (the tensor comparison is now reduced to the two separate computation statements). Thus the two object formulas hold for every given resolution without choosing another resolution.
